data.name: Bitcoin District
data.description: Bitcoin District is a community of Bitcoiners in the DMV area who network, socialize, and learn from one another. They host meetups, a book club, and an events calendar.

data.name: Bitcoin District Initiative
data.description: A 501(c)(3) nonprofit empowering DC residents and businesses through Bitcoin education, helping people accept payments, save securely, and use Bitcoin with confidence.

data.name: Satoshi Action Fund
data.description: The Bitcoin advocacy organization working with lawmakers to ensure Bitcoin and mining can positively impact the environment, grid, and society. 20M+ Americans protected, 9 laws passed.

data.name: Unchained
data.description: Unchained helps you secure Bitcoin with cold storage you control, plus trading, inheritance, loans, and IRAs. Thousands secure over $10B through multisig vaults and business services.

data.name: Sovreign
data.description: Sovreign helps businesses build with better money through education, strategy, and technical support for treasury management and multisig. Based at Strategy Hub, Tysons Corner.

data.name: The Bitcoin Commons
data.description: The Bitcoin Commons is a mathematically specified, consensus-valid alternative full node implementation for Bitcoin.

data.name: Endless Mining
data.description: Endless Mining is the crypto mining marketplace for ASIC miners, hosting, and consulting at competitive rates for new and used equipment.

data.name: Split
data.description: Split is a Bitcoin social rewards wallet: self-custodial Lightning payments, encrypted Lightning-address messaging, and rewards for verified merchant spending in support of the circular economy.

data.name: Simple Proof
data.description: Simple Proof timestamps digital documents using Bitcoin and OpenTimestamps for enterprise-scale integrity. Screven County, GA used it to secure 2024 election results.

data.name: BitVault
data.description: BitVault protects Bitcoin with time-delayed multisig against physical attacks and hacks. Open source, non-custodial, integrates with major hardware wallets.

data.name: Carbon Country
data.description: Carbon Country transforms farms by combining agrivoltaics, carbon removal, and BTC mining, selling organic meat, carbon credits, and maximizing returns.

data.name: Commonwealth Cyber Initiative
data.description: Virginia's main access point for cybersecurity research and workforce development. Hub members contribute Bitcoin-specific research.

data.name: Geeks of the Valley
data.description: A podcast featuring industry trailblazers in VC, blockchain, and fintech, with a newsletter and deal flow.

data.name: Lightning.news
data.description: Covers breaking Bitcoin and Lightning Network stories: news, events, policy, adoption, and interviews.

data.name: Bitcoin Prophets
data.description: A Bitcoin investment fund and lifestyle brand with a shop, podcast, library, and blog.

data.name: DMV Women & Bitcoin
data.description: DMV Women & Bitcoin brings together women in or curious about Bitcoin, sharing experiences, career paths, and lessons through panels and discussions.

data.name: Second Gate
data.description: A boutique advisory firm advising growth companies and investors across the Bitcoin ecosystem: strategy, M&A, due diligence, and deal sourcing.

data.name: Bitcoin Comms
data.description: Low time preference PR and communications services for Bitcoin and freedom-focused technology projects.

data.name: 21Allies
data.description: 21 Allies connects the Bitcoin industry with advisory, fundraising, brand strategy, and digital marketing services.
